brief.label: 업무 정리
brief.use: Turn a request into a brief: goal, scope, done-when, and who does what.

plan.label: 전략 수립
plan.use: Write a change plan: scope, order of steps, risks, and checks that prove it worked.

code.label: 코드 작성
code.use: Change code the way the project already works and confirm each change is saved.

tools.label: 빠른 점검
tools.use: Run quick checks on what changed: the touched tests, a type check, or a plain run.

review.label: 코드 리뷰
review.use: Judge one change for behavior, edge cases, test coverage, breakage and security.

verify.label: 전체 검증
verify.use: Run the project's full test suite and build exactly as the project defines them.

debug.label: 실패 분석
debug.use: Read a failure, rerun it alone, and say whether it is real, flaky, or older than the change.

style.label: 표준 점검
style.use: Judge whether one change fits the project: structure, names, comments, leftovers, standard library first.

research.label: 출처 조사
research.use: Find facts in official sources and cite each with its URL and the date read.

image.label: 이미지 처리
image.use: Read, describe, crop, resize, and convert images with what the machine already has.

hire.label: 인력 설계
hire.use: Design a new crew member: role, tools, model, and instructions.

kit.label: 도구 관리
kit.use: Bring in a skill or MCP server and give it only to the members whose work needs it.

report.label: 보고서 양식
report.use: Write a report to keep: lead with the conclusion, then evidence, then what could not be checked.

browser.label: 브라우저
browser.use: A real browser (Playwright MCP): open and operate web pages, read pages that need scripts, take screenshots.
